# Capsimg for Retroarch Commodore Amiga (PUAE)

This is the Capsimg (IPF) library for use with Retroarch Commodore Amiga (PUAE) core

Supported OS: Android, Windows, MacOS, Linux, Rapsberry Pi

# Installation

- find the .so file or .dll file for your platform. For example, Android/armeabi-v7a/capsimg.so if you are running an older 32bit Android device, or Windows/x86-64/capsimg.dll if you are running a 64bit build of Windows.

- copy the relevant file to your Retroarch system folder on your device. You can find (and change) your Retroarch system folder by loading up Retroarch and going to Settings->Directories.

- once the library is present in your system folder, you should now be able boot .ipf files
